ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white distal regions to low-intensity black central and proximal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions occupying the distal third of both lobes. High-density black mottling and circular focal spots concentrated at the transition zones between the white distal areas and the black central peduncle region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 82 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the distal trailing edges. The right lobe exhibits a more regular saw-tooth pattern compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory from the median notch extending towards the tips, with a slight distal taper.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white pixels indicating barnacle colonization on the extreme distal tips of both lobes and along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct horizontal high-intensity linear disruptions visible on the dark peduncle region just above the waterline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on lobe tips; visible irregular 'notching' or material loss on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Crescent-shaped dark pigmentation mark located on the white distal surface of the left lobe.
